wake-wide.intent: Open wide on cosy toy bedroom at dawn. Pip wakes tired in bed, sits up droopily. Large headline reads the premise with sound off. Locked camera.

shuffle-out.intent: Cut closer in bedroom. Pip shuffles slowly across rug toward the doorway, still half asleep. Locked camera.

kitchen-enter.intent: Change place: wide sunny toy kitchen. Tired Pip shuffles in from left toward the counter where the cold brew can waits. Locked camera.

find-drink.intent: Cut closer at kitchen counter. Pip reaches for the cold brew can, lifts it and drinks. Product is clear and hero-sized in frame. Locked camera.

hero-jump.intent: Low heroic angle in kitchen, hero moment. Energised Pip leaps high for joy beside the counter, arms up, then lands beaming. Locked camera.

can-closer.intent: End answering the opening: close on the cold brew can on the kitchen counter, Pip joyful in soft background giving thumbs up. Locked camera.
